features.label: Populariser, not philosopher
features.detail: He is why Stoicism went mainstream. That is a real contribution and a real limitation at once.

features.label: Came from marketing
features.detail: A media strategist by training. Reading him aware of the packaging is more useful than pretending it is not there.

features.label: Use him as a door
features.detail: His own advice is to go to the sources. It is the most frequently ignored thing he says.
